---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible software failure with redacted evidence
title: "bug: "
---

## Observed and expected behavior

Describe the input, operation, expected result, and actual result.
For a potential vulnerability, follow the security policy instead of disclosing exploit details publicly.

## Reproduction

Give the smallest reproducer and exact command output.
Use synthetic phone numbers and redact credentials, MAC addresses, tailnet identities, audio, and private paths.

## Environment

Give the commit, operating system, architecture, tool versions, and relevant gateway firmware.
State whether the failure occurs in the mock lab or on hardware.
